items.title: DECISION D1 - Module authority location
items.body:
Each <module-root>/manifest.json is the authoritative source for module-specific facts after cutover.

Policy approved; authority cutover remains blocked. See resolution_decisions.json.

items.title: DECISION D2 - Meaning of single authority
items.body:
EAFIX_auth_docs/01_canonical_registries/process_registry.jsonl remains canonical for global process steps/order/topology. Module manifests reference it.

Policy approved; authority cutover remains blocked. See resolution_decisions.json.

items.title: DECISION D3 - Schema evolution
items.body:
All 34 active root manifests must use eafix_unified_atomic_module_schema_v2_0_0.json at coordinated cutover.

Policy approved; authority cutover remains blocked. See resolution_decisions.json.

items.title: DECISION D4 - Decision authority
items.body:
Accepted meaningful fields require evidence addressable by stable field path/JSON Pointer and source locator.

Policy approved; authority cutover remains blocked. See resolution_decisions.json.

items.title: DECISION D5 - Automation boundary
items.body:
A changed supporting document creates a reconciliation proposal, not an automatic manifest mutation.

Policy approved; authority cutover remains blocked. See resolution_decisions.json.

items.title: DECISION D6 - Header and archive policy
items.body:
Archived originals preserve exact bytes. Notices live in sidecars/README or annotated prose copies.

Policy approved; authority cutover remains blocked. See resolution_decisions.json.

EAFIX_auth_docs/manifests/eafix_module_manifests_bundle.vNext.schema_valid.json is generated from the 34 roots and is not permitted to feed root manifests.

Policy approved; authority cutover remains blocked. See resolution_decisions.json.
